channel.title: Simple Product Picks - USB-C Hubs & Docking Stations UK
channel.description: Buying guides for USB-C hubs and docking stations. Every link verified against the live Amazon listing.

item.title: Best USB C Hub For Dual Monitors 2026
item.description: The best USB-C hubs for a dual-monitor setup, chosen for two 4K displays from one port, wired Ethernet and power delivery. Three picks compared.

item.title: Best USB C Hub For MacBook Air M1 2026
item.description: The best USB-C hubs for the MacBook Air M1: add HDMI, USB-A, card readers and Ethernet from its two ports. Three picks, and how they suit an iPad Pro.

item.title: USB C Hub Vs Docking Station 2026
item.description: The difference between a pocket USB-C hub and a full docking station, in plain English, plus three picks across both camps for a bag or a fixed desk.

item.title: Best USB C Docking Station 2026
item.description: One cable for displays, wired network and accessories. Three USB-C docking stations compared on screens, ports and laptop power, plus what a ThinkPad needs.

item.title: Best USB C Hub 2026
item.description: USB-C hubs sorted by the ports you need: a 5-in-1, a 7-in-1 with Ethernet and SD, and a 10-in-1 desk dock, plus the one to dock a Steam Deck with.

item.title: Does A KVM Switch Add Lag
item.description: Anker says a KVM switch can add latency, often to imperceptible levels on a good one. Where the delay on a swap comes from, and when a USB-only switch is enough.

item.title: Best KVM Switch 2026
item.description: A KVM switch shares one keyboard, mouse and screen between two computers. USB-only, HDMI single and dual-monitor, and DisplayPort picks, matched to your setup.

item.title: Best USB-C Monitor for a One-Cable Desk 2026
item.description: One USB-C or Thunderbolt cable can carry your screen, laptop charge and peripherals. Three monitor picks matched to how much power your laptop needs.

item.title: Docking Station Not Detecting Your Monitor? Here's Why
item.description: Why a USB-C dock won't drive your second monitor - your laptop's display limit, a DisplayLink dock that needs its driver, and the quick checks in order.

item.title: Do You Need A Powered USB Hub?
item.description: When a USB hub needs its own power supply and when a bus-powered one is fine - the power-budget question that decides it, and the devices that make a hub drop out.

item.title: Can An iPad Use An External Monitor?
item.description: Which iPads only mirror to a monitor, which can extend onto it with Stage Manager, the cable or hub you need, and why a mirrored iPad leaves black bars.
